add_memories.description: Extract durable facts from a conversation (or a block of text) and store them in Mem0 against a user, agent, run or app.

mock_response.message: Memory processing has been queued for background execution

add_memories.name: add_memories

parameters.description: What Mem0 should remember. Pass a block of text, or the conversation turns as a list of objects, e.g. [{"role": "user", "content": "I moved to Austin last month."}]. Roles are user, assistant or system.
parameters.name: messages

role.description: Who said it: user, assistant or system. Defaults to user.

parameters.description: The person these memories belong to, your own identifier for them, e.g. 'alice' or a customer id. Supply at least one of User ID, Agent ID, Run ID or App ID.
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: The AI agent these memories belong to, e.g. 'support-agent'.
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.description: The session or run these memories belong to, for short-term memory scoped to one conversation.
parameters.name: run_id

parameters.description: The app these memories belong to, e.g. 'helpdesk'.
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description: Optional key/value data to attach to every memory this call extracts, e.g. {"source": "onboarding_form"}. You can filter on it later.
parameters.name: metadata

parameters.description: Let Mem0's extraction model pull the facts out of the messages. Turn this off to store the text exactly as given, which also makes the call finish immediately instead of being queued.
parameters.name: infer

parameters.description: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD) the memories stay visible through. After it passes they are hidden from search and get-all unless expired memories are included.
parameters.name: expiration_date

event_id.description: Identifier for the queued extraction job. Empty when fact extraction was turned off, because that path completes immediately.

status.description: Job status: PENDING while extraction is queued, then SUCCEEDED or FAILED.

delete_memory.description: Permanently delete a single memory by its ID.
delete_memory.name: delete_memory

parameters.description: The ID of the memory to act on, as returned by Search memories or Get memories.
parameters.name: memory_id

id.description: The ID of the deleted memory.

get_memories.description: List everything Mem0 has stored for a user, agent, run or app, one page at a time.

results.memory: Alice moved to Austin in June 2026

get_memories.name: get_memories

parameters.description: The person these memories belong to, your own identifier for them, e.g. 'alice' or a customer id. Supply at least one of User ID, Agent ID, Run ID or App ID.
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: The AI agent these memories belong to, e.g. 'support-agent'.
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.description: The session or run these memories belong to, for short-term memory scoped to one conversation.
parameters.name: run_id

parameters.description: The app these memories belong to, e.g. 'helpdesk'.
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description: Optional. Extra conditions combined with the IDs above, e.g. {"categories": {"contains": "finance"}} or {"created_at": {"gte": "2026-07-01"}}. Supports AND, OR, NOT and the in/gte/lte/gt/lt/ne/icontains operators.
parameters.name: filters

parameters.description: Include memories whose expiration date has passed. They stay stored after expiring but are hidden by default.
parameters.name: show_expired

parameters.description: Which page of results to return. Starts at 1.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: How many memories per page (1-200). Defaults to 100.
parameters.name: page_size

next.description: URL of the next page, or null on the last page.

previous.description: URL of the previous page, or null on the first page.

categories.description: Categories Mem0 classified the memory under.

expiration_date.description: Date the memory expires (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if permanent.

id.description: Unique memory identifier, used to update or delete it.

metadata.description: Metadata attached to the memory when it was added.

search_memories.description: Search stored memories in plain language and get the most relevant ones back, each with a relevance score.

results.memory: Alice moved to Austin in June 2026

search_memories.name: search_memories

parameters.description: What to look for, in plain language, e.g. 'What are Alice's food preferences?'.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: The person these memories belong to, your own identifier for them, e.g. 'alice' or a customer id. Supply at least one of User ID, Agent ID, Run ID or App ID.
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: The AI agent these memories belong to, e.g. 'support-agent'.
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.description: The session or run these memories belong to, for short-term memory scoped to one conversation.
parameters.name: run_id

parameters.description: The app these memories belong to, e.g. 'helpdesk'.
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description: Optional. Extra conditions combined with the IDs above, e.g. {"categories": {"contains": "finance"}} or {"created_at": {"gte": "2026-07-01"}}. Supports AND, OR, NOT and the in/gte/lte/gt/lt/ne/icontains operators.
parameters.name: filters

parameters.description: How many memories to return (1-1000). Defaults to 10.
parameters.name: top_k

parameters.description: Drop results scoring below this (0-1). Defaults to 0.1; set 0 to keep everything.
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.description: Run Mem0's reranker over the matches for better ordering. More accurate, but slower.
parameters.name: rerank

parameters.description: Include memories whose expiration date has passed. They stay stored after expiring but are hidden by default.
parameters.name: show_expired

results.description: The matching memories, most relevant first.

categories.description: Categories Mem0 classified the memory under.

expiration_date.description: Date the memory expires (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if permanent.

id.description: Unique memory identifier, used to update or delete it.

metadata.description: Metadata attached to the memory when it was added.

score.description: Combined relevance score between 0 and 1 (semantic, keyword and entity signals fused).

update_memory.description: Change a single memory's text, metadata or expiration date.

mock_response.memory: Alice moved to Austin in June 2026 and works downtown

parameters.description: The ID of the memory to act on, as returned by Search memories or Get memories.

parameters.description: The replacement text for the memory.
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: Replacement key/value data for the memory, e.g. {"category": "preferences"}.
parameters.name: metadata
